properties.name: myjpa-plus.soft-delete.auto-filter
properties.description: Enable automatic soft-delete filtering for entities annotated with @SoftDelete.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.soft-delete.block-unconditional-delete
properties.description: Block unconditional hard-delete operations on entities with @SoftDelete field.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.max-results
properties.description: Default maximum number of rows returned by findAll and find methods.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.deep-pagination-offset-threshold
properties.description: Offset threshold for deep pagination warning log.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.deep-pagination-offset-limit
properties.description: Hard limit for deep pagination offset. Set to -1 to disable.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.in-clause-max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of parameters in a single IN clause batch.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.in-clause-hard-limit
properties.description: Hard limit for IN clause total parameters. Exceeding this throws an exception.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.lambda-cache-size
properties.description: Maximum size of the Lambda property name cache.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.default-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Default query timeout in seconds. Set to -1 to disable.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.max-bulk-operation-rows
properties.description: Maximum rows affected by bulk operations. Set to 0 to disable.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.extra-safe-functions
properties.description: Additional safe function names to add to the whitelist for func() method. Function names are case-insensitive.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.query.extra-boolean-functions
properties.description: Additional boolean-returning function names to add to the whitelist for func() method. Function names are case-insensitive.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.monitoring.enabled
properties.description: Enable SQL slow query monitoring via DataSource proxy.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.cache.auto-invalidation-enabled
properties.description: Enable automatic cache invalidation when entities are modified.

properties.name: myjpa-plus.auto-repository-base-class
properties.description: Automatically register DefaultMyJpaRepository as the base class for all repositories.
